projects.title: Agentic Scientific Research Assistant
projects.short_description: An agentic research platform combining scientific paper retrieval with structured oceanographic data analysis.
resume_bullets: Developed an agentic RAG system for scientific research, integrating retrieval from oceanographic research papers with structured oceanographic data.
Implemented BM25 and vector search with cross-encoder reranking to improve retrieval relevance.
Built an LLM-based query router using Groq API to direct queries to paper retrieval, dataset analysis, or combined workflows.
projects.portfolio_description: An AI-powered scientific research assistant that combines paper retrieval, semantic search, reranking, and structured dataset analysis.

projects.title: Neural Network from Scratch
projects.short_description: A neural network implemented from scratch to understand the mathematical foundations of deep learning.
resume_bullets: Implemented a neural network from scratch in Python and NumPy to understand forward propagation and backpropagation.
Implemented weighted layers, activation functions, loss computation, gradient calculation, and parameter updates.
Trained and evaluated the model while analyzing learning behavior without relying on high-level deep learning frameworks.
projects.portfolio_description: A foundational deep learning project implementing neural network components and training mechanics using Python and NumPy.

projects.title: Urban Heat Mitigation using AI/ML
projects.short_description: An ML-based approach to analyze urban heat patterns in Delhi using satellite-derived environmental and urban features.
resume_bullets: Developing an ML-based approach to analyze urban heat patterns in Delhi using satellite-derived environmental and urban features.
Processed Landsat and Sentinel-2 imagery to derive LST, NDVI, NDWI, EVI, and NDBI.
Engineered geospatial features including land cover, tree cover, population density, elevation, slope, and distance to water.
projects.portfolio_description: A geospatial AI/ML project analyzing urban heat patterns through satellite imagery, environmental indices, and engineered urban features.
